    goal = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float)
    for it in range(maxsteps):
        jp = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
        jr = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
        mujoco.mj_jacSite(m, d, jp, jr, site)
        pos_err = goal - d.site_xpos[site].copy()
        ori_err = Rotation.from_matrix(Rgoal @ d.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3).T).as_rotvec()
        J = np.vstack((jp[:, dids], 0.12 * jr[:, dids]))
        err = np.r_[pos_err, 0.12 * ori_err]
        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + 0.0004 * np.eye(6), err)
        dq = np.clip(dq, -0.07, 0.07)
        a = actions[-1].copy() if actions else s.initial_command()
        a[:7] = np.clip(d.qpos[qids] + dq, qlo, qhi)
        a[7] = grip
        a[8:12] = 0.0
        a[12] = -1.0
        actions.append(a)
        s.step(a)
        if np.linalg.norm(pos_err) < 0.008 and np.linalg.norm(ori_err) < 0.03:
            break
    print(f"{label or 'servo'}: {it + 1} steps, site={np.round(d.site_xpos[site], 3)}, fish={np.round(d.xpos[m.body('obj_main').id], 3)}")
